title: 2410. Maximum Matching of Players With Trainers

examples.explanation: One of the ways we can form two matchings is as follows: - players[0] can be matched with trainers[0] since 4 <= 8. - players[1] can be matched with trainers[3] since 7 <= 8. It can be proven that 2 is the maximum number of matchings that can be formed.
The trainer can be matched with any of the 3 players. Each player can only be matched with one trainer, so the maximum answer is 1.
